rationale: Dataset reconnaissance requires comprehensive profiling of structure, identifiers, temporal coverage, and joins. Load and schema components establish baseline structure and produce data_contract.json. Missingness with all_columns scope reveals entirely-empty columns (dx3–5, modifiers, denial codes in medical claims) indicating data quality issues. Duplicate_check now verifies all candidate keys including both the simple adherence.member_id key and the composite adherence key (member_id + therapeutic_class), as the previous plan missed the standalone member_id verification in the adherence table. Date_ranges with consistency_checks=true detects temporal anomalies such as enrollment_end uniformity and service/adjudication date ordering violations. Join_check across all six relationships exposes the critical pharmacy-provider mismatches (pharmacy_npi and prescriber_npi show 0% match rate to providers table). Report with cite_artifacts=true and caveats including synthetic_data and sample_preview produces reproducible documentation that clarifies the synthetic nature of the data and that sample values shown are previews only, linking every finding to source artifacts.
changes_summary: Added adherence.member_id as a standalone key to duplicate_check to fully verify candidate keys in the adherence table. Added synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats to write_report to clarify that the dataset is synthetic and that sample values shown are illustrative only.
